# The PHP Book

> A beginner's guide to PHP: written for people who already know how to program, taking them from installation through building and testing real command-line and web projects with modern PHP (8.x).

## Front matter

[The PHP Book](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/): title page and table of contents.
[Foreword](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/foreword.html): why this book exists and who it's for.
[Introduction](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch00-00-introduction.html): how the book is organized and how to read it.

## Getting started

[Getting Started](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch01-00-getting-started.html): overview of the setup chapter.
[Installation](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch01-01-installation.html): installing PHP and Composer.
[Hello, World!](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch01-02-hello-world.html): the first PHP script, `echo`, and running scripts from the command line.
[Hello, Composer!](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch01-03-hello-composer.html): starting a project with Composer and its autoloader.

## Guessing game tutorial

[Programming a Guessing Game](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch02-00-guessing-game-tutorial.html): a first complete program, tying together input, loops, and comparisons.

## Common programming concepts

[Common Programming Concepts](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-00-common-programming-concepts.html): overview of variables, types, functions, comments, and control flow.
[Variables, Constants, and Mutability](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-01-variables-and-mutability.html): declaring variables and constants, and PHP's default mutability.
[Data Types](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-02-data-types.html): scalar and compound types, type juggling, and casting.
[Functions](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-03-how-functions-work.html): declaring functions, parameters, return types, and default values.
[Comments](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-04-comments.html): comment syntax and docblocks.
[Control Flow](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch03-05-control-flow.html): `if`, loops, `break`, and `continue`.

## Variables and references

[Working with Variables and References](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch04-00-variables-and-references.html): how PHP actually stores and shares values.
[How PHP Manages Values: Copy-on-Write](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch04-01-copy-on-write.html): why copying an array or string is cheap until it's modified.
[Passing by Value vs. by Reference](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch04-02-references.html): the `&` reference operator and when a function can mutate the caller's variable.
[Variable Scope and Garbage Collection](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch04-03-scope-and-gc.html): local versus global scope, and how PHP reclaims memory.

## Classes

[Using Classes to Structure Related Data](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch05-00-classes.html): introduction to object-oriented PHP.
[Defining and Instantiating Classes](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch05-01-defining-classes.html): properties, visibility, constructor promotion, and `readonly`.
[An Example Program Using Classes](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch05-02-example-classes.html): a worked example that puts classes to use.
[Methods and Constructor Promotion](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch05-03-methods.html): defining methods and `$this`.

## Enums and pattern matching

[Enums and Pattern Matching](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch06-00-enums.html): overview of enums and the `match` expression.
[Defining an Enum](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch06-01-defining-an-enum.html): pure and backed enum cases.
[The `match` Expression](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch06-02-match.html): strict-comparison branching that returns a value.
[Concise Control Flow with `match` and `?->`](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch06-03-match-and-nullsafe.html): pairing `match` with the nullsafe operator.

## Namespaces, packages, and Composer

[Namespaces, Packages, and Composer](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-00-namespaces-and-composer.html): organizing code across files and packages.
[Packages and Autoloading](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-01-packages-and-autoloading.html): how Composer's autoloader finds and loads classes.
[Controlling Scope and Visibility with Namespaces](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-02-namespaces.html): the `namespace` keyword and name resolution.
[Referring to Code with the `use` Keyword](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-03-use-keyword.html): importing names from other namespaces.
[Organizing a Multi-File Project](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-04-organizing-a-project.html): splitting a growing project across multiple files.
[Separating Classes into Different Files (PSR-4)](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch07-05-psr4.html): the PSR-4 autoloading convention.

## Common collections

[Common Collections](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch08-00-common-collections.html): overview of arrays and strings.
[Storing Lists of Values with Indexed Arrays](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch08-01-indexed-arrays.html): PHP's array type used as an ordered list.
[Storing UTF-8 Encoded Text with Strings](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch08-02-strings.html): strings, encoding, and common string functions.
[Storing Keys with Associated Values in Associative Arrays](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch08-03-associative-arrays.html): PHP's array type used as a map, `isset()` versus `array_key_exists()`.

## Error handling

[Error Handling](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch09-00-error-handling.html): overview of `Error`, `Exception`, and `Throwable`.
[Unrecoverable Errors: Fatal Errors and `Error`](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch09-01-fatal-errors.html): PHP's `Error` hierarchy for programmer mistakes.
[Recoverable Errors with Exceptions](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch09-02-exceptions.html): `try`/`catch`/`finally`, `throw`, and custom exceptions.
[To Throw or Not to Throw](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch09-03-to-throw-or-not-to-throw.html): deciding between exceptions and other error-signaling strategies.

## Web development basics

[Web Development Basics](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch10-00-web-development-basics.html): overview of forms, superglobals, security, and databases.
[Accepting Input with HTML Forms and Superglobals](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch10-01-forms-and-superglobals.html): reading `$_GET`, `$_POST`, and `$_SERVER` from an HTML form.
[Validating Input and Preventing Cross-Site Scripting](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch10-02-validation-and-xss.html): `htmlspecialchars()`, input validation, and XSS/CSRF awareness.
[Talking to a Database with PDO](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch10-03-talking-to-a-database.html): PDO, SQLite, and prepared statements against SQL injection.

## Interfaces, traits, and generic-style code

[Interfaces, Traits, and Generic-Style Code](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch11-00-interfaces-and-traits.html): sharing behavior across unrelated classes.
[Defining Shared Behavior with Interfaces](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch11-01-interfaces.html): programming against a contract instead of a concrete class.
[Reusing Code with PHP Traits](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch11-02-php-traits.html): sharing method implementations across classes.
[Generic-Style Code with Docblocks and Static Analysis](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch11-03-generic-style-code.html): approximating generics with docblocks, PHPStan, and Psalm.

## Writing automated tests

[Writing Automated Tests](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch12-00-testing.html): why and how to test PHP code.
[How to Write Tests with PHPUnit](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch12-01-writing-tests.html): assertions and test structure with PHPUnit.
[Controlling How Tests Are Run](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch12-02-running-tests.html): filtering, grouping, and configuring test runs.
[Test Organization](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch12-03-test-organization.html): structuring unit and integration tests in a project.

## Debugging

[Debugging PHP](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch13-00-debugging.html): overview of print debugging and step debugging.
[Print Debugging with `var_dump()` and `print_r()`](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch13-01-print-debugging.html): inspecting values and their types with `var_dump()`, `print_r()`, and `var_export()`.
[Step Debugging with Xdebug](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch13-02-xdebug.html): installing Xdebug, breakpoints, stepping through code, and profiling.

## A CLI project

[A CLI Project: Building a Command Line Program](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-00-a-cli-project.html): introduces a `grep`-like command-line tool, built up over several chapters.
[Accepting Command Line Arguments](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-01-accepting-command-line-arguments.html): reading `$argv` and parsing CLI options.
[Reading a File](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-02-reading-a-file.html): opening files and reading from `STDIN`.
[Refactoring to Improve Modularity and Error Handling](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-03-improving-error-handling-and-modularity.html): splitting the CLI project into smaller pieces and handling failures properly.
[Adding Functionality with Test-Driven Development](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-04-testing-the-librarys-functionality.html): extending the project test-first.
[Working with Environment Variables](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-05-working-with-environment-variables.html): reading configuration with `getenv()` and `$_ENV`.
[Writing to Standard Error](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch14-06-writing-to-stderr.html): separating error output from normal output with `STDERR`.

## Functional features: closures and generators

[Functional Features: Closures and Generators](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch15-00-functional-features.html): treating functions as values and producing values lazily.
[Closures and Arrow Functions](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch15-01-closures.html): anonymous functions, `use`, and `fn`.
[Processing a Series of Items with Generators](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch15-02-generators.html): `yield` and lazy iteration.
[Improving Our CLI Project](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch15-03-improving-our-cli-project.html): applying closures and generators to the CLI project.
[Performance: Loops vs. Generators vs. Array Functions](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch15-04-performance.html): memory and speed trade-offs between the three approaches.

## More about Composer and Packagist

[More About Composer and Packagist](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-00-more-about-composer.html): going beyond basic dependency installation.
[Customizing Autoload and Scripts](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-01-customizing-composer.html): custom autoload rules and Composer scripts.
[Publishing a Package to Packagist](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-02-publishing-to-packagist.html): sharing a package with the PHP community.
[Composer Path Repositories and Monorepos](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-03-composer-monorepos.html): working with local path repositories and monorepos.
[Installing Global Tools with Composer](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-04-installing-global-tools.html): installing CLI tools globally versus per-project.
[Extending Composer with Scripts and Plugins](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch16-05-extending-composer.html): hooking into Composer's lifecycle.

## Object-oriented PHP

[Object-Oriented PHP](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch17-00-object-oriented-php.html): a deeper pass through PHP's object model.
[Classes, Inheritance, and Polymorphism](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch17-01-inheritance-and-polymorphism.html): `extends`, `parent::`, and overriding behavior.
[Abstract Classes and Interfaces Revisited](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch17-02-abstract-classes.html): abstract classes and abstract methods.
[Magic Methods](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch17-03-magic-methods.html): `__construct`, `__destruct`, `__toString`, `__get`/`__set`, `__call`, and friends.
[Implementing a Classic OOP Design Pattern](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch17-04-oop-design-patterns.html): a worked design pattern example.

## Concurrency in PHP

[Concurrency in PHP: A Brief Tour](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch18-00-concurrency.html): overview of how PHP handles concurrent work.
[The PHP Request Model: Why PHP Is (Usually) Single-Threaded](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch18-01-request-model.html): the shared-nothing, one-request-per-process model.
[Background Work with Queues and Processes](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch18-02-queues-and-processes.html): offloading work with queues and separate processes, including `pcntl`.
[A Look at Fibers and Async Libraries](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch18-03-fibers-and-async.html): Fibers and cooperative concurrency.

## Patterns and matching

[Patterns and Matching](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch19-00-patterns.html): overview of `match` and destructuring as pattern tools.
[Where `match` and Destructuring Can Be Used](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch19-01-all-the-places-for-patterns.html): a survey of pattern-shaped code across the language.
[List and Array Destructuring](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch19-02-destructuring.html): unpacking arrays with `list()` and `[...]` syntax.
[`match` Pattern Syntax](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch19-03-match-syntax.html): multi-value arms and matching idioms.

## Advanced features

[Advanced Features](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch20-00-advanced-features.html): overview of reflection, built-in interfaces, and attributes.
[Magic Constants and Reflection](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch20-01-reflection.html): `__CLASS__`, `__FUNCTION__`, and inspecting code at runtime with Reflection.
[Built-in Interfaces: Countable, ArrayAccess, IteratorAggregate](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch20-02-built-in-interfaces.html): making custom objects work with `count()`, `[]`, and `foreach`.
[First-Class Callable Syntax and Advanced Closures](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch20-03-advanced-closures.html): `foo(...)` syntax and closure binding.
[Attributes](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch20-04-attributes.html): `#[...]` metadata and reading it with Reflection.

## Final project: a web application

[Final Project: Building a Simple Web Application](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch21-00-final-project-web-app.html): a small MVC-style web app that ties the book's concepts together.
[A Single-File Router with PHP's Built-in Server](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch21-01-single-file-router.html): routing requests with PHP's built-in development server.
[Structuring a Small MVC-Style App](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch21-02-mvc-structure.html): separating models, views, and controllers.
[Handling Shutdown and Cleanup](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ch21-03-shutdown-and-cleanup.html): `register_shutdown_function()` and cleanup logic.

## Appendix

[Appendix](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-00.html): reference material, meant for looking things up rather than reading straight through.
[A - Keywords](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-01-keywords.html): every reserved word in PHP, grouped by purpose.
[B - Operators and Symbols](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-02-operators.html): a reference table of PHP's operators and symbols.
[C - Built-in Interfaces and Magic Methods](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-03-built-in-interfaces.html): SPL interfaces and magic methods gathered in one place.
[D - Useful Development Tools](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-04-useful-development-tools.html): Composer, PHPUnit, PHPStan/Psalm, code style tools, Xdebug, and editors.
[E - PHP Versions and Backward Compatibility](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-05-php-versions.html): version support and compatibility notes.
[F - Translations of the Book](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-06-translation.html): translation status of the book.
[G - How PHP Is Made (the RFC Process)](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-07-rfc-process.html): how language changes are proposed and voted on via PHP's RFC process.
[H - Covered PHP Features](https://thephpbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/appendix-08-php-features.html): every PHP feature covered in the book, linked to its entry in the [PHP Dictionary](https://php-dictionary.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
